messages:
Marisol P.: quick sync — pricing question: customers keep asking for 'burst credits' + per-route soft caps. thinking about 2 approaches: (A) unified tier bands with built-in surge credits, (B) base + explicit addons (burst pack, priority routing). open to tradeoffs.
Kevin L.: curious on SLO/implementation. unified bands -> simpler UX but harder to guarantee isolation. burst packs -> easier to schedule on Dedicated.
Raj S.: sales feedback: large customers prefer explicit line items for renewals. small self-serve users prefer simple bands.
Amanda T.: finance: explicit addons let us meter revenue to addons; unified bands easier to forecast usage (less churn). need to model ARR impact.
Zach W.: from solutions: addons cause probs during procurement. can we do hybrid: tiers + prepaid credit token that's billable and auto-applies?
Marisol P.: proposal: Tier (Core / Scale / Enterprise) with optional 'credit sculpting' addon. credit sculpting = prepaid credits + policy (soft floor, surge multiplier). For Dedicated we can support reserved tokens.
Kevin L.: implementation notes:
```
policy: {
  prepaid_credits: int,
  soft_floor_pct: float,
  surge_multiplier: float
}
```
KV cache interactions and routing need flags. Will add to spec.
Raj S.: questions: contract constraints? do we allow unused credits roll-over? we see ask for annual rollover.
Amanda T.: prefer 90-day expiry for credits; rollover complicates revenue recognition.
Marisol P.: Launch criteria (MVP): 1) billing + UI to buy credits, 2) routing policy enforcement, 3) analytics dashboard. MVP no rollover. Evaluate customer pilots for rollover.
Zach W.: ✅ can do pilot w/ AcmeCorp next quarter.
Kevin L.: estimate: 3 sprints backend + 2 sprints UI + infra tweaks. need eng-cap from runtime team.
Marisol P.: Decision: go hybrid (unified tiers + purchasable credit packs), MVP no rollover, pilot with AcmeCorp. I'll draft spec + gantt. @Kevin L. can you review constraints by EOD Fri?
Kevin L.: on it.
pricing-bot: new doc created: /specs/pricing/credit-sculpting-draft-v1 — link: https://redwood/specs/PR-987
Marisol P.: thanks all :heart:
